name: BACH_0186
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (52%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Low reliability (40%) and split Normal vs Benign (43%) read; recut and deeper levels are drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 52%, Benign 43%, InSitu 5%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Split between Normal and Benign |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% dataset coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot separate Normal from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 40% (flagged), OOD 32nd percentile [F6] | Suspect input; recut or levels drafted |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (models disagree) | Independent models disagree on class |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (89%–92%); 1/5 Benign (BACH_0341, 90%) [F5] | Mostly Normal, close Benign neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasion score (z=1.53), failed 0/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 3, 4) · context · Above-typical score (z=1.55), 8/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (z=0.77) against invasive carcinoma [F4] · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclei counts** (regions 8, 10, 11) · context · 38 connective, 2 epithelial, 1 neoplastic nucleus; insufficient tumor nuclei · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in deletion tests (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197 excludes 0, n=132); all region risks here are 0%.
- **Concepts**: Unproven in deletion tests (95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); top driver normal_lobules (0/20) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is a benign lesion (43% probability, in conformal set, 90% similar to Benign case BACH_0341).
- Flagged section quality (40% reliability) or sparse epithelium (2 epithelial nuclei across regions 8, 10, 11) masks disease.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 9, 10**: Verify benign stroma and true two-layered lobules, as normal_lobules is unreliable (0/20).
2. **Regions 0, 3, 4**: Assess lymphocytic infiltrate and ducts to distinguish Normal from Benign contrast case BACH_0341.
3. **Regions 8, 10, 11**: Check epithelial adequacy and slide quality; order drafted recut or deeper levels if needed.
